# LeadPipe MCP

> LeadPipe MCP is an MCP server that gives small businesses without a CRM a scored, bookable lead pipeline on Google Sheets and Calendar, with dedup, stage validation and approval-safe writes. By TechAurah.

Key facts:

- License: MIT. Runtime: Python 3.11+, official MCP SDK, stdio transport.
- It is not a CRM and sends nothing to anyone: no messages, no calendar invites.
- Write modes: direct, dry-run, approval. Approval is the default with real credentials.
- Demo mode runs the full walkthrough offline with a fake client and 12 seed leads.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp): Full overview, quickstart, comparison and FAQ
- [Schema](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp/blob/main/docs/schema.md): The three-tab Sheet schema (Leads, AuditLog, Meta), the scoring model and the stage transition map
- [Safety model](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp/blob/main/docs/safety.md): Write modes, the approval flow and booking guardrails
- [Client config](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp/blob/main/docs/client-config.md): Claude Desktop and Cursor registration for demo and real mode

## Examples

- [Demo walkthrough](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp/blob/main/examples/demo_walkthrough.py): All eight tools end to end on the fake client, runnable with zero credentials
- [Examples index](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp/blob/main/examples/README.md): What each example shows and what it needs

## Use it

- [Install from source](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp): Clone the repo, run pip install -e . and follow the README quickstart
- [Releases](https://github.com/techaurah/leadpipe-mcp/releases): Version history and downloads
